topic: Reviewing software build stability and deployment
summary_markdown: The conversation centered on the release of a specific software version (v24.10.1.2812-stable). While some features were noted as positive, concerns were raised regarding performance improvements and overall stability, suggesting waiting for more mature builds. Despite this caution, it was agreed to deploy the build onto the sandbox environment.
decisions: The software version v24.10.1.2812-stable will be deployed to the sandbox.
